parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: Point the lens at a distant object, such as a window across the room, and hold a screen behind the lens. Move the screen until a sharp image of the window is formed on it. Measure the distance from the lens to the screen. This distance is the focal length.

parts.label: (a)
parts.answer:
TV and computer: 2.0 kWh
kettle: 0.40 kWh
lights: 2.4 kWh
water heater: 0.70 kWh
air conditioner: 9.0 kWh

parts.label: (b)
parts.why: total 14.5 kWh [1]; 14.5 × 0.31 is 4.50, not 4.05 → answer mark withheld

parts.label: (c)
parts.answer: The water heater has a much higher power, so a larger current flows in its wires. A thicker wire has a lower resistance, so less power is lost as heat and the wires do not overheat.

parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: The surrounding (room) temperature.

parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: Polystyrene. After 25 minutes only 30 g of ice melted in the polystyrene bowl without a lid, but 79 g melted in the paper cardboard bowl.

parts.label: (c)
parts.answer: With a lid, air is trapped above the ice. Air is a poor conductor of heat, so less energy is transferred to the ice by conduction.

parts.label: (d)
parts.answer: Light-coloured, because a light surface is a poorer absorber of infra-red radiation.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.answer: 340 J of energy is transferred for every 1 g of water to change between the solid and liquid states, at constant temperature.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.answer: As the water freezes the particles slow down, so their kinetic energy decreases and the internal energy decreases.
parts.why: the scheme wants potential energy falling with kinetic energy unchanged; kinetic energy falling contradicts the constant temperature → 0

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.answer:
Cooling the water: Q = mcΔθ = 500 × 4.2 × 25.0 = 5 250 J
Freezing: Q = ml = 500 × 340 = 170 000 J
Cooling the ice: Q = mcΔθ = 500 × 2.1 × 3.0 = 3 150 J
Total = 5 250 + 170 000 + 3 150 = 178 400 J
parts.why: both formula marks given; 500 × 4.2 × 25 slipped to 5 250 and carried, so the total is 178 400 J, not 226 000 J → answer mark withheld

parts.label: (a)
parts.answer:
Beta particles are fast-moving electrons, but gamma rays are electromagnetic waves.
Beta particles are charged, but gamma rays have no charge.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.answer: Radioactive decay is random and spontaneous.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.why: average 38.5 [1]; the volume has no unit (cm³) → answer mark withheld (convention)

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.answer:
16 days = 2 half-lives
Count rate = 40 ÷ 2 = 20 per second
parts.why: "1 mark for recognising 2 half lives" given; halved only once, so 20, not 10 → answer mark withheld

parts.label: (c)
parts.answer:
It must have a short half-life.
It must not be poisonous to the body.
